name: London
summary: Mix free museum time with one or two paid historic sights. Group days by area so underground travel does not consume the visit.
seasonNote: Rain is possible all year; summer and school holidays are crowded, while winter daylight is short.
arrival: Identify the airport first: Heathrow, Gatwick, Stansted, Luton and City have different routes and fares.
gettingAround: Use contactless or Oyster where supported; use the same card or device for entry and exit. Walk adjacent river districts.
cashTip: Cards dominate; a small GBP reserve is sufficient for many visits. Check foreign-card conversion fees.
foodTip: Try market lunches, a full breakfast or a neighbourhood curry; queues are not a quality guarantee.
buyTip: Browse independent design, books and food gifts; compare souvenir pricing away from major landmarks.
baseArea: Bloomsbury, South Bank or another well-connected central district

connections.note: Approximate train time; arrive early for required check-in and border formalities.
